thread:
maria-ops: paging: seeing a big surge of Okta introspect 429/502s in eu-west-1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Users hitting login failures and console 401s. alert: authz.gateway.introspect.errors spiked. paging oncall now.
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED oncall (sev2) — PagerDuty incident #PD-92741 triggered for authz.gateway.introspect.errors — responders: oncall-primary.
alex-platform: on it, looking at prometheus + logs. quick check: net of requests to /introspect -> 200 -> then sudden 502 bursts. 09:12 -> 09:20 window shows retries stacking.
samir-sre: can you paste a raw response from Okta? suspect upstream rate-limiting or jwks propagation.
alex-platform: here's a curl I ran against our introspect proxy:
```
curl -i -X POST https://introspect-eu.internal.example.com -d 'token=xxx'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream_service_error","detail":"502 from okta-introspect-eu"}
```
jamie-support: customers already rasing tickets, some report console login fails intermittently. iirc a few large EU customers affected. status page?
status-okta-bot: Okta status: "Partial outage impacting Introspect in EU-1. Investigating" — https://status.okta.com/incidents/abc-123 (updated 09:18 UTC).
maria-ops: quick assessment: initial metric shows ~18% failure rate on interactive login flows for EU tenants between 09:12-09:22. API token verif for some backend jobs also hit 5xx.
alex-platform: mitigation idea: throttle retries and add local introspect queue + short-lived cache for verification results to avoid thundering herd. also consider switching to secondary introspect endpoint if available.
samir-sre: propose immediate mitigations (fast):
- increase jwks/cache TTL on authz-proxy from 60s -> 300s (`auth.jwks_cache_ttl: 300`)
- enable soft-fallback: accept cached token verifications for console sessions for up to 2m
- apply client-side backoff to introspect requests (10r/s per node)
I can roll these in staging then to euw canary.
oncall-2: soft-fallback for console is fine but need to limit scope (UI sessions only) — don't fallback for admin APIs. security ok?
samir-sre: agreed — scoping rule: `resource_type == console && tenant_region == eu-west-1` only. adding audit log entry when fallback used.
alex-platform: performing rate-limit update now:
```
POST /admin/configs/rate-limits
{"service":"authz-proxy-euw","introspect_rps":10}
```
applied to the proxy pool. watching metrics.
incidents-bot: Severity escalated to SEV2 (business impact: login failures for EU tenants). Next update cadence: 15m.
jamie-support: CS notified affected customers (template sent). currently 28 open tickets referencing login/console errors. no reports of data exposure.
samir-sre: logs showing pattern: upstream returns 200s with high latency then 502s as queues overflow. sample trace: 
```
[09:14:21] authz-proxy-euw handler: upstream_latency=3200ms status=502 upstream_id=okta-introspect-eu
java.lang.RuntimeException: upstream timeout -> 502
```
maria-ops: can you add a temporary routing rule to divert new introspect traffic to our eu-secondary node pool (if capacity)? we need quick relief.
alex-platform: spun up a small aux pool and routed 20% of traffic to eu-secondary. initial drop in errors from 18% -> 9% over 3m. rolling to 50% now.
samir-sre: continuing deep-dive: correlating Okta incident timeline with our client retries. prepping a list of affected tenants to share with CS.
jamie-support: forwarding list to customers flagged as impacted. Ops/Legal looped in.
maria-ops: handoff: i need to jump to exec sync. handing incident to samir for investigation and next updates. samir you are oncall lead.
samir-sre: ack — taking over. will post updates every 15m and notify if we need to escalate to vendor support. current actions: cascade routing, rate-limit, jwks cache bump, soft-fallback for console. next: collect request traces and contact Okta support with payload. ETA 30m for initial RCA draft.
alex-platform: monitoring: error rate trending down to ~6% after routing + throttles. latency still elevated. will keep watch and set an alert if >10% in 5m window.
incidents-bot: Reminder: attach postmortem template to thread when incident closed.
samir-sre: security note: fallbacks are audit-logged and limited by scope, no long-term acceptance. post-incident we'll revert TTL changes once upstream stable. tagging compliance.
jamie-support: CS update queued to customers: "We detected an issue with a third-party auth provider affecting EU logins; mitigation in progress; next update in 30m."
maria-ops: thanks team. if errors re-spike after 09:50 UTC, page escalation to oncall-2.
samir-sre: handing monitoring to alex-platform for next 30m while i continue vendor debug. will update timestamped findings.
oncall-2: available if needed.
status-okta-bot: Okta update 09:39 UTC: "Investigating; mitigation in progress; some customers seeing improvement" https://status.okta.com/incidents/abc-123
samir-sre: last note for now — incident still open, degradations reduced but not fully resolved. postmortem: yes. will include timeline, mitigation steps, and customer impact numbers. signing off active watch, will reopen thread if we see regression.
